description: Defines the TensorDataContainer class and related functions for handling various tensor data representations in PyTorch's C++ codebase, including nested initializer lists, tensors, and scalars.

classes.name: TensorDataContainer
classes.description: A class supporting conversion of nested initializer lists, vectors, and tensors into a unified tensor representation, with methods for conversion, printing, and filling tensors.

methods.name: compute_desired_dtype
methods.description: Determines the appropriate tensor data type based on the input scalar type, aligning C++ tensor creation with Python behavior.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Overloads the stream insertion operator to pretty-print a TensorDataContainer.

methods.name: convert_to_tensor
methods.description: Converts the TensorDataContainer into an at::Tensor with specified options, handling scalars, init lists, and existing tensors.

methods.name: pretty_print_recursive
methods.description: Recursively prints the contents of the TensorDataContainer for debugging or display.

methods.name: fill_tensor
methods.description: Fills a given tensor with the data contained in the TensorDataContainer, supporting nested structures.
